summary: fix(queue): skip verify retries on baseline failure and prepend project venv in sandbox

delivery.outcome: Prepend project and parent worktree .venv/bin and node_modules/.bin to PATH in verification_sandbox.py, omit cache_dir when cacheprovider is disabled, and skip verify retries on unrecoverable VERIFY_BASELINE_FAILED outcomes.
nonGoals: Do not weaken read-only filesystem or seccomp isolation in verification_sandbox.py

architecture.decision: Resolve existing .venv/bin, venv/bin, and node_modules/.bin directories from the staged project and parent worktree root in verification_sandbox._sandbox_path, guard PYTEST_ADDOPTS against no:cacheprovider, and filter unrecoverable or unchanged VERIFY_BASELINE_FAILED outcomes in patch_retry._is_verify_failure.

validation.evidence: Unit tests for sandbox PATH resolution, PYTEST_ADDOPTS handling, and unrecoverable VERIFY_BASELINE_FAILED retry skipping.
